title: Cover activity visibility controller behavior in the maintained UI suite
outcome: The maintained UI gate checks observable activity-animation visibility controller behavior rather than only the unsupported-IntersectionObserver fallback.
acceptance: Maintained tests exercise intersection visibility, dynamic indicator tracking/reclassification, document visibility or motion-preference resynchronization and teardown using observable attributes/animation state.
The tests fail when the controller leaves indicators running offscreen or fails to release observer/listener state, without pinning CSS text, instruction files or duplicating the implementation.
